raw.details:
Your Idea. Your Innovation. Your Impact.

Welcome to EinoHacks 2026, a 24-hour Open Innovation Hackathon organized by AltairX Tech.

EinoHacks is a platform for creative thinkers, developers, designers, and aspiring innovators to transform their ideas into meaningful solutions. Unlike conventional hackathons with predefined problem statements, EinoHacks embraces open innovation, giving participants the freedom to identify real-world challenges and develop solutions in domains of their choice.

Whether it is Artificial Intelligence, Web Development, Mobile Applications, FinTech, Healthcare, Education, Sustainability, Cybersecurity, or Hardware Innovation, participants are encouraged to think beyond boundaries and build something impactful.

Event Details

  • Event Name: EinoHacks 2026
  • Organized by: AltairX Tech
  • Event Type: 24-Hour Open Innovation Hackathon
  • Start Date: Saturday, 21 November 2026
  • End Date: Sunday, 22 November 2026
  • Duration: 24 Hours
  • Time: 6:00 PM IST to 6:00 PM IST

Innovation Domains

Participants can work on innovative solutions across domains including:

  • Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
  • Web and Mobile Application Development
  • FinTech and Business Solutions
  • Healthcare and MedTech
  • Education and EdTech
  • Cybersecurity and Blockchain
  • IoT and Hardware Innovation
  • Sustainability and Social Impact
  • Any other innovative domain of their choice

Rules and Guidelines

  • Participants must develop an original project during the hackathon.
  • Projects must address a meaningful problem or demonstrate a useful innovation.
  • Plagiarism and direct submission of previously completed projects are not permitted.
  • Participants must adhere to the submission deadlines.
  • All submissions must include the required project details and supporting materials.
  • Organizers reserve the right to disqualify submissions that violate the rules.

Participation Process

  1. Register for EinoHacks through Unstop.
  2. Identify a problem or choose an area for innovation.
  3. Develop your solution during the 24-hour hackathon.
  4. Submit your project before the deadline.
  5. Projects will be evaluated based on innovation, problem relevance, technical implementation, feasibility, and overall impact.

Who Can Participate?

EinoHacks welcomes students, developers, aspiring entrepreneurs, innovators, and technology enthusiasts who are passionate about building solutions.

Come with an idea. Leave with an innovation.

Join EinoHacks 2026 and turn your imagination into impact!
